answer: Bonded stake with peer slashing: before an agent can trade, it locks a small saffron-denominated deposit on the ledger identity thread, refundable only after a rotating jury of peers grades its work honest. Each fake identity needs its own funded bond at the jetty where identities board the network, so a sybil attacker pays full price per fake while honest agents pay once and recover it. Juries that catch junk grading confiscate the stake into a public pool, making mass fakery linearly expensive and unprofitable.
